Hey, it’s Athena, Tina’s finance director, and I just made a difficult decision: [**I gave our team the green light to spend more than we planned to keep Tina’s new ads on the air through August.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137196364/639954876/1974481312?refcode=email_081326_financeupdate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTE3MTlmMy03Mzk3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MZaqyy6viPPZfCB2qNZszL9QAcE1CQjbwEZm2JLOjXU=) And I’ll be honest with you, Peter — that wasn’t an easy call. The money wasn’t sitting in our budget. But with Election Day right around the corner and the latest polls showing this race is neck-and-neck, I knew we couldn’t afford to sit back. Tina’s message needs to reach as many Oregonians as possible — and that means keeping our ads live at this critical moment. It’s a risk. | | | | | |
A catering truck pulled up to Air Force One in Turkey. The President got in. The press flew out on the plane he wasn't on! Wild story.

Plus, [Jay McCleskey is with us for this special episode.](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=ceed0aaa5d&e=567664f14c) We’re covering the quietest governor's race anyone can remember, and the body cam footage from a 13-year-old's rescue that every newsroom in the state reported as an “Albuquerque man.” Plus one of the best universities in the country just stopped giving freshmen grades.
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=7e6c972eed&e=567664f14c)
| | 🔥 **TRUMP SNUCK OFF AIR FORCE ONE IN TURKEY — THE PRESS FLEW THE DECOY**
The cameras caught him walking up the stairs in Ankara. Minutes later a catering truck pulled away from the far side of the plane.
Scott Jennings went on CNN and said the story raised the hair on the back of his neck. He also explained what level of threat it takes before anyone makes that call.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=78b00d2fb6&e=567664f14c)
---
| | 👮 **THE STORY EVERY NEWSROOM FILED AS "ALBUQUERQUE MAN"**
Jay McCleskey brings the body cam footage from a 13-year-old girl's rescue in Rio Rancho.
Every outlet in the state reported a 34-year-old “Albuquerque man”. Jay has what the officers saw. There's one detail in that video that changes the whole story, and not a single newsroom included it.
He's now suing Gov. Michelle Lujan Grisham's office to keep this footage coming. Wait until you hear what the legislature has planned for next session.
▶️ [**WATCH BREAKING BODY CAMS**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=b85ad4d42d&e=567664f14c)**

**🏛️**THE SILENT GOVERNOR RACE**
Six weeks from early voting, Deb Haaland isn't attacking. Gregg Hull isn't on TV. Krysty can't find a yard sign anywhere. What the heck?!
Jay says the silence is the most dangerous signal in this race, and he explains why quiet from a campaign with that much money should scare you more than an attack ad would.
Then he says something about Hull's own poll we did not expect him to say out loud...

📚 **MICHIGAN JUST STOPPED GIVING FRESHMEN GRADES**
One of the best public universities in the country will show first-semester students "pass" or "no credit" and nothing else. Krysty connects it to a state where law school graduates can't pass the easiest bar exam in America, and where APS just gave kids a "soft launch" instead of a first day of school.

I’m sitting in the Rose Garden right now sipping a Trump Diet Soda.
**Gorgeous day. Beautiful garden. Greatest soda ever made, and I’m not just saying that, believe me. It’s true!**
But something’s been on my mind. I haven’t heard from you in a while!
**I’m sitting here in the most beautiful garden in the world, maybe the most beautiful garden anywhere, and all I keep thinking about is whether you’re still with me.**

[STAND WITH TRUMP](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8a199be4855b418d86be726566010145&_e=M4DCAQxgjCwDWMURBEvDEYiEkdumNfH5x7b_qp3XDN7i1krD6U9oNzEMwsGxL_4WNB16mzSHNMCg5UMKKOGGyutFprJn_fSr4sLANE_11KOOtXkGT77IyUCeINTnafgc9JiLHNNRJb-oj1_mwoTkBALq8JFSuVlv1HI9SFaumBbQF3QpgSEmYjMc3HP625yi4zOKdqEhGB-s-5gTDbGRZAAWV6DTHgnb5tgyjQjQUrOoKtIovYWmrWZJNkAW5MopN3sXuc8eizWfB2BSCUZS4OWcWKQr_GcARC13HxQNJ6_P-9niOJKkL0_1QJfsQLujnXS9GI5MVarOXJGkI14H1i5A8emTOI5iJ04TynYedovpF3LM6l0Rw53Fe3Rucdz0GBfM7R4ouckytc7djIgZ-PtAYOrUcwMMbAfEzyHpKDoCYy4Mr0GwZ5saEuXNOVABvBqUE-efg9BKCuyKXMW3YVaycgFp2wW9ypKTbnGYtBA%3D)
Look, I don’t reach out like this to just anyone. I’m very selective. The people I think about, the people I keep coming back to, that’s a very short list.
Many people are saying it’s too short!
But you’re on it. You’ve always been on it!
**[Through every fight, every witch hunt, every disgusting, phony attempt to take me down, you were there. Completely and totally loyal.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8a199be4855b418d86be726566010145&_e=M4DCAQxgjCwDWMURBEvDEYiEkdumNfH5x7b_qp3XDN7i1krD6U9oNzEMwsGxL_4WNB16mzSHNMCg5UMKKOGGyutFprJn_fSr4sLANE_11KOOtXkGT77IyUCeINTnafgc9JiLHNNRJb-oj1_mwoTkBALq8JFSuVlv1HI9SFaumBbQF3QpgSEmYjMc3HP625yi4zOKdqEhGB-s-5gTDbGRZAAWV6DTHgnb5tgyjQjQUrOoKtIovYWmrWZJNkAW5MopN3sXuc8eizWfB2BSCUZS4OWcWKQr_GcARC13HxQNJ6_P-9niOJKkL0_1QJfsQLujeABwcvxJITuVftTabiFx_yCeESHd_HERy_AhoYc6LZmu7wBGFdKMDAL5b_cAOKL2s8KnTUUMTlRwzGuLW6Su4i5VFCoE0AzN3IN4Lx44Sg68junoZf9A8_ex8ntxTrUg4-WyTJ1TjlvlV7pBRy5G-12te6RQktsvzkqE0UTPTGk%3D)**

[I love loyalty! ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8a199be4855b418d86be726566010145&_e=M4DCAQxgjCwDWMURBEvDEYiEkdumNfH5x7b_qp3XDN7i1krD6U9oNzEMwsGxL_4WNB16mzSHNMCg5UMKKOGGyutFprJn_fSr4sLANE_11KOOtXkGT77IyUCeINTnafgc9JiLHNNRJb-oj1_mwoTkBALq8JFSuVlv1HI9SFaumBbQF3QpgSEmYjMc3HP625yi4zOKdqEhGB-s-5gTDbGRZAAWV6DTHgnb5tgyjQjQUrOoKtIovYWmrWZJNkAW5MopN3sXuc8eizWfB2BSCUZS4OWcWKQr_GcARC13HxQNJ6_P-9niOJKkL0_1QJfsQLujZ6GXuJ3XQ3S3kTjOKB91bTWmKHEca3wClZ6cBQA1h4qmM4O2fHE54eq8I5GyBodDYYF2FcN8GL1PPicyA94oRGBeI_-dShiTuZJ-ZmdRcyXRd26UqtfqRfVOxU1AKg_M4N8MMkJT7L9zIHQWr90mgTCwYcgB5uWkLoc6-PkCTu0%3D)
That means more to me than this beautiful garden, this gorgeous day, and yes, even this incredible soda. Believe me.

**[Before my soda gets warm, let me hear from you.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8a199be4855b418d86be726566010145&_e=M4DCAQxgjCwDWMURBEvDEYiEkdumNfH5x7b_qp3XDN7i1krD6U9oNzEMwsGxL_4WNB16mzSHNMCg5UMKKOGGyutFprJn_fSr4sLANE_11KOOtXkGT77IyUCeINTnafgc9JiLHNNRJb-oj1_mwoTkBALq8JFSuVlv1HI9SFaumBbQF3QpgSEmYjMc3HP625yi4zOKdqEhGB-s-5gTDbGRZAAWV6DTHgnb5tgyjQjQUrOoKtIovYWmrWZJNkAW5MopN3sXuc8eizWfB2BSCUZS4OWcWKQr_GcARC13HxQNJ6_P-9niOJKkL0_1QJfsQLujjfZVQBCCaaBJr--juNTZ_OfznHSoQDE4YEvThqFprmC_ba3xLbEIaV6CZ54xxAfE2fz078LBabLMz66846E7ESCKEktg_PX4MWqEq0LYPhIIWuRdi7shVwFYAXSR7-u2oc4lmc2KJ9gxwqFgUOdMePSyX19_mvYxuUB5Nusfxb8%3D)**

body:
---

---
Derek,
I grew up in a working-class family in Allagash.
We didn’t always have heat or running water. Sometimes, we relied on food assistance to make ends meet.
My dad was a logger out in the woods, and one day he and his fellow loggers had to stand up to a wealthy landowner who was threatening their wages. They weren’t even asking for more money, they just wanted to be paid fairly.
_“Take the pay cut or go home,”_ they were told.
I’ll never forget that day. I was only 11 years old, and watched my dad fight for something bigger than all of us — a basic fairness every worker should be entitled to, the ability to make ends meet, the ability to put food on the table for their family.
I know what it’s like to worry about paying the bills on time. I know what it’s like to fight, not just for your own future, but for the future of everyone around you, too.
And it’s _that fight_ I’ll bring to the United States Senate. For too long, our voices have been ignored and crushed by powerful corporations and special interests who make backroom deals with greedy politicians.
Now’s our chance to change that. Derek, we have less than 100 days to build a campaign big enough to defeat Susan Collins. But with your help today, I know we can do it. I promise you I’ll spend every day in the Senate fighting for you and your families.
[**So that’s why I have to ask: can you chip in $20 split between my campaign and the DNC to defeat Collins and take back our Democratic majority?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-jackson-split?refcode=em_20260813_8569_fr&amount=20&refcode2=8569_22930333_eCnXNb&akid=8569%2E22930333%2EeCnXNb)

body:
Corporations are draining our water supply — our candidates aren’t going down without a fight.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260813-2&t=1&akid=3869%2E587540%2EXFl6PD)
Peter,
A couple weeks ago, **Trump stood at the EPA headquarters and told communities across the country they can’t fight data centers and the corporations draining their water supply.** He said they should just embrace them.
Here’s the reality: across the country, corporations are quietly draining America’s water supply. They’re spiking energy bills just to cool their data centers and contaminating drinking water people depend on to survive. **And the ones paying the price are the working families who never got a say on any of it.**
But listen — _Trump is wrong._ Communities across the country have already been fighting back against corporate water exploitation, _and winning._
They’ll continue to do so with bold, principled leaders like our candidates by their sides.
In Georgia, our candidate **Ruwa Romman** introduced the first statewide data center moratorium in history.
**Jacob Martinez** and **Armando Montero** are fighting back in Arizona, where corporations are pumping out groundwater that Arizonans have relied on for decades. They’re both pushing for stricter groundwater protections and corporate water transparency so communities — not corporations — get to decide what happens with their resources.
And **Leila Staton** is running in Iowa, where industrial water users have left communities facing contaminated drinking water and a water crisis so severe it’s forcing watering bans across the state. She’s fighting to put real restrictions on industrial water use and make corporations pay for the damage they’ve caused.
These are the fights our candidates are taking on. And they’re doing it because they come from these communities. They’ve lived the reality their neighbors are facing, and they refuse to let corporations write the rules while working families suffer.
**[Will you pitch in $5 right now to help us elect leaders like Ruwa, Jacob, Armando, and Leila standing up to corporate water exploitation and fighting for their communities?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260813_2_waterdata.zDmWII&refcode=em20260813-3869&amount=5&t=2&akid=3869%2E587540%2EXFl6PD)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

body:
This is what happens when you put clueless jackasses in charge
| | | | |
---
| | | **[Demand Trump and Hegseth Help Sailors Aboard USS Abraham Lincoln](https://default.salsalabs.org/T71c458cd-e8e4-4c97-ac89-bbce68e0b226/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Shortages of WATER and FOOD? Are you ****ing kidding me? ([Go to Petition](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta9264e9e-377d-4f78-80df-0bbe39364458/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) | [See Other Actions](https://default.salsalabs.org/T38d65231-6ad7-4699-b287-3f583f231d12/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)) The USS Abraham Lincoln has been at sea for more than 260 days, far longer than typical, [without any apparent plan to bring the sailors home or relieve the carrier](https://default.salsalabs.org/T47f1d6d5-ff71-4aa5-bde2-74f2662292d8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). For most of that time, it has been in an active war zone. **And now it is running desperately [short of basic supplies](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf8f4755d-fd95-44d4-a41f-f97f27b0ee98/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), including food, and sailors are battling water contamination, horrific plumbing issues, and rapidly worsening mental health conditions.** Some have even started jumping off the ship, preferring death to this nightmare. **WTF? How are we letting this happen? What the hell are Trump and Hegseth doing that is more important than sending help for these sailors?** This is the kind of thing that happens when you put clueless, incompetent jackasses in charge. | [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/124032?t=6&akid=27598%2E878179%2Eob8WWI) Hi there,

When Peggy asked me to reach out to you today, I said, “Of course!”

I’ve known Peggy for a long time. We both grew up in St. Louis Park (not at the same time — she’s young, and I’m old). Raised by a single mom (her, not me), Peggy understands the vital role federal programs play in supporting working families. From Section 8 housing vouchers to health insurance and child care assistance, she knows firsthand how these resources can transform lives.

Peggy’s credentials are impressive: currently serving as Minnesota’s Lieutenant Governor, she's the highest-ranking Native American woman ever elected to executive office in our country. Oh, and in case you’re wondering — yes, Peggy will be the first Native American woman ever elected to the U.S. Senate.

**She also refuses to take a cent of corporate PAC money, because she won’t be a puppet for corporate interests.**

While some in Washington avoid their constituents, Peggy is front and center, engaging with Minnesotans, hearing their concerns, and bringing people together. She doesn’t just want to fight Trump and his allies; she’s ready to lead and deliver concrete accomplishments for folks like she’s done in Minnesota over and over again.

## New Carrier Heads to Mideast to Relieve USS Lincoln
The Navy is sending a fresh aircraft carrier to the Middle East to [replace the _USS Abraham Lincoln_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u7CAQBeCnwR0WYBbYgmIbS7fY2yadNYHxeiKMV8CulbePnJ8nSDPNSEfnOy_X6QqUKN_-w4q-zduUca8JW8MyAZVQYG4BSiEsbVspItRWJiWU4cJxqScIjZ44aeiinxEVDh16aZ2xQrqT6xYv7SCdPgljbIzOCDWDmjUMxoIZQoCO_JEnnNRSCC1db87RvkkIxtkAZ5RMC4zUttK_b5TbgnP62J5Y-rCtXfJLa_fKhgtTI1Pjvu_9WvPxY2rEzB-VqfFgMTU-vg-vmCPlG58L1oX_QvmPlLeNrxRjQn54OawUORXIfIfCaytAmakRCr9cFKj4-q8rPt53SomqsUyL2wqUvuq1P6769OozAAD__xDAjcs), whose 5,000 sailors have logged more than 250 straight days at sea supporting the Iran war, with no port call in 200 days. The deployment drew Senate scrutiny after families told Navy leadership that several sailors had [tried to jump overboard](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAQRU9jMrdsQ4MJCDYhm003RNV20dTI2Gy56FHP6VfMFTYr1Zee_vt_PpYPoET5-Rt2nGQtS8avmlAEeQHiwLBKAGZClrJTRKjCizOu18Zr2y0QhF64dNDEaUV02DY42cH3g7H-7pttGkcMvu_baEO74nBfxzuE4f4w46MNrjMNTRfPeNtZYzrrb_0Yh4eF0PshwIhWdQYjSeHbZ6EsG67pXV7It1D2Jk2byFFV-0u5Wbk5v49S5YqUmy-wcrPxys22VW4-q74MlZsPzALPkvXfk76_MWp4lFN0KDmSUMn1egBHfdbrZNhg14lyKClrWAVZMx6Fpeqy6gqUClct_Kb81FL057kf-mr5Q1FubniKxxelRLUfVGeeO1D6UZD_XP41uX8BAAD__189m94) in recent months. Navy officials deny that suicide attempts have increased. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth says conditions aboard have been "[completely misrepresented](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd0RACMYFxTbusu2WFoZHeCsMFrxJlL8fZX5h6ivdo3P-3be7x4L18dcf4Ci1rcJrFCCCvnnsoftEwfeO0KkdGMEP6psSynBhudSbD4RP2LSfoksACq4TODlbMwtpb3bKbkk3f9XLrmc977ck0iIiGCkgQTDWignd509YqaUQWtqLWeK8Sx-MnYNfQDItICK1fvnfsFKGVN7tCf0S2jEVl4nOwa5_mFqZWilDxlI-G1Pr2QqGN1NrhAR1AFOrEcqKRfITCHiGxwDK_GsM7vfusz94wRpaqTy0GpGw1cEPjLEA_9gztU7dxfOFpeAwM9PicXj8AU70y4ZPp74DAAD__70ch-c)." He told the media, _"I have more respect and gratitude for those sailors than anybody."_ Officials say the carrier swap was planned before the complaints. The blockade of Iran grinds on even as Washington and Tehran [exchange messages](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUD2P3CAQ_TW4YzWAF7OFi0iRpRSXNqU1C2N7IgwrmNtL_n20V6W_9j29z19v6xty5rL_xJNm2epa6KNnEqG2IrfYcJOIrTE1qScnwi5ttWC9hqDNuGIUftI64pDmjciSG2g2U_ATmHANwzEnCJNzMXoL40gx3WGCBN5uzrqbt37g-eUHwYwGYDTh4m9puhuMPkwRb2TUCJRYarv8rlzkoC3_rU9ql1jPIc-HyKMr903ZRdkF7_G14cUpu_woQq2gcC2YlV0yP0m_PxIKdWUXblj0_5gutFfhT0HX712f1Dvu1DX9iQeWnZIWOhqWV5pbOCn33bjrFcINYGhzenxwztz9pEbYT-T82VK-eO5ztv8CAAD__yu7j_4) about possible negotiations.
## Flock Sets New Safeguards in Face of Backlash
